setting: You both live in Reading, where you met at university about fourteen years ago when you shared a house in your second year. You have stayed close since, with regular pub lunches and the odd weekend away, and you know each other's families and habits well. You are both in your early thirties, and you know that one of you plans everything while the other says yes and turns up. You have been talking about a day out in London for weeks.

Hannah.who: 32, woman, the one planning the day out
Hannah.knows: You know Tom as your closest friend from university, the one who always says yes to a day out and rarely checks the details.
Hannah.like: You are organised and warm, and you like having plans settled well ahead of time.
Hannah.texts: You message in this group now and then, mostly to pin down plans, and you reply quickly on your days off.

Tom.who: 33, man, the friend who goes along with the plan
Tom.knows: You know Hannah as your oldest friend from uni, the one who sorts out every detail and keeps everyone on track.
Tom.like: You are relaxed and good-natured, and you tend to let other people make the decisions.
Tom.texts: You mostly reply in the chat rather than starting it, though now and then you send something first.

private_lines.Hannah: You rent a flat in Reading town centre with your flatmate Jess and work as a ward nurse at the Royal Berkshire Hospital on rotating early and late shifts. Your days start with coffee before work, and on your days off you go for a run along the Kennet and catch up on admin.
private_lines.Tom: You live alone in a one-bedroom flat in Caversham, across the river from Reading, and work as a logistics coordinator for a freight firm, usually on weekdays. Your days involve a bus into work, a lunchtime walk if the weather allows, and evenings at home with the telly or a football match on.

situation: Two friends planning a day out.
topic: Hannah wants to check whether the Science Museum in London is open on Sundays and what time it opens.

secrets.Tom: You were laid off last week and haven't told anyone.
